mocked_api.notes: All APIs are real implementations using TenantDataProvider to fetch data from uploaded CSV files stored in MongoDB.

TENANT_DATA_PROVIDER.feature: TenantDataProvider service layer for dynamic data
components: get_categories() - returns categories from style_master upload
get_channels() - returns channels from store_master upload
get_asp_by_category() - returns ASP from sales data
get_seasonality_factors() - returns monthly seasonality from sales
get_channel_splits() - returns revenue share per channel
validate_data_availability() - checks what data has been uploaded

response_fields: has_data: boolean - true if uploaded data exists
categories: array - from uploaded data or fallback
channels: array - from uploaded data or fallback

behavior: GREEN banner when has_data=true: 'Using uploaded data: X categories, Y channels'
AMBER banner when has_data=false: 'No uploaded data yet — using default categories'
